ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Kubernetes Secret or Config Object Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies when a Kubernetes account access a sensitive objects such as configmaps or secrets. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/CONFIGMAPS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/CONFIGMAPS\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/SECRETS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/SECRETS\/DELETE")
